# Mission Canvas

> Software built around how your business works, running on your own computers. We audit the workflow, build the application and hand it over. No per-seat fees.

Mission Canvas builds private AI software for small and mid-sized businesses. Each engagement starts with a workflow audit, then the application is built from a working starting point for the industry (a "canvas") and runs on the business's own computers. Licensed per company, with no per-seat fees. Book an audit: https://missioncanvas.ai/audit/

## Palette⁠&trade;, a free local AI app for your documents.
Give it one folder. It reads only what you allow, on your computer, and links every line to its source. Get Palette free
Sound familiar?
Software shouldn't need a workaround for the workaround.
Every company has them.
The spreadsheet that fixes the CRM.
The manual check that keeps the process from going wrong.
The person everyone asks because the system doesn't tell them what to do.
It's easy to call this "just how we work." It isn't. It's what happens when the software stops matching the business.
You know where the hours go. We build the software around how you actually work, so your team stops making up for it.
How it works

## From the way you work to software you can run, in four to six weeks.
01 Audit 02 Redesign 03 Assemble 04 Operate

### Audit
We sit with your team and map how work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where time goes. What you get
Process map · Where the hours go How long it all takes
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds.

### Redesign
We cut the steps that only exist to move information from one system to another. What you get
The new way of working, on paper How long it all takes
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds.

### Assemble
We start from the working application for your industry, change it to fit, and build the parts only you need. What you get
Your application, set up How long it all takes
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds.

### Operate
The software takes over repeat work: data entry, reports, filing. We measure it and adjust it with your team. What you get
Running in your business How long it all takes
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.

## Questions.
What is Mission Canvas?
Software built around how your business already works, running on your own computers. We audit how the work moves, build the application from a working starting point for your industry, and hand it over to you. Who is it for?
Small and mid-sized businesses whose work runs on documents, records and rules. That includes construction, education, logistics, front desk and voice, events and venues, with healthcare and office work in progress. What do you build beyond a chat interface?
Mission Canvas builds an application around an agreed workflow, with the inputs, review steps and output your team needs. We scope the local processing and any outside connections before delivery. What happens in the audit?
We sit with your team and map how the work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where the time goes. You get a process map and a list of where the hours go. No contract, nothing to prepare. How long does it take?
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds.

About Mission Canvas

# AI should back up your expertise, not replace it.
We help businesses see, own and improve the work that matters most, with AI they can answer for.

## The team.

### Jason Covington
Fractional CFO, CPO and COO practice.

### Mical Neill
Twelve years in voice and knowledge systems.

### Daniele Mulas
IT, and making things useful to real people.

### Pierfrancesco Borghero
Running development teams.

## What we believe.

### Own your workflows. Don’t rent your intelligence.
What your company knows sits in email, calendars, documents, drives and people’s heads. We connect it on hardware you control.

### You decide what runs where.
Requests run on your machines. You decide what leaves, which AI models are used, and why.

### Work should be visible.
Spreadsheets changed finance. Computer-aided design changed engineering. We want you to see how work flows, and improve it.

## What we’re working toward.
These are outcomes we’re working to prove, not results we claim today.

### Give people their time back
Cut repetitive work, so attention goes to people, ideas and decisions.

### Make AI understandable
Systems you can see into, explain and check. No black boxes.

### Connect what you know
Turn scattered information into something your team can search and share.

### Keep what people know
Capture how work is done before it leaves with someone who retires.

### AI for everyone
Let anyone design a workflow, not only developers and data scientists.

### Work better together
Let teams build, share and improve their workflows together.

### Earn trust
Privacy, security and human oversight first. Technology should earn trust, not demand it.

## Wherever paperwork piles up.
Healthcare is where this matters most. Patient information needs clearly defined access and processing boundaries. With Mission
Canvas, sensitive work stays on a local model, and every answer records the path it took.
The same approach works in education, logistics, legal, financial services, government and manufacturing.

Download

# Download the apps.
Desktop apps for Mac, Windows and Linux. They run on your own computer.

## Palette
Free. Try it on your own files.
Mac Windows Linux

## Education
Education workspace
Mac Windows Linux

## After it downloads.
- Mac Open the.dmg and drag the app into Applications. Palette is signed and notarized.
If macOS still says the app can't be verified, right-click it and choose Open.
- Windows Run the -Setup.exe installer. It is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen shows
"Windows protected your PC": click More info, then Run anyway.
- Linux Palette is a.deb: open it with your software installer, or run
sudo apt install ~/Downloads/MissionCanvas.deb. The other apps are.AppImage files,
which download without permission to run, so double-clicking does nothing. In a terminal, chmod +x
the file, then run it. On Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, first sudo apt install libfuse2. On Ubuntu 24.04 an
AppImage may quit at once with a "SUID sandbox" error; start it with --no-sandbox.
For developers

## Install the command line.
A terminal build for asking questions against a repository or a folder. It ships on its own release train and is
not the same build as the apps above. Developer docs
macOS / Linux curl -fsSL https://missioncanvas.ai/install-cli.sh | sh
Windows irm https://missioncanvas.ai/install-cli.ps1 | iex

# Bring the job that keeps coming back.
Tell us how the work moves between people, documents and systems. If you support other businesses, start with one customer workflow. Keep confidential details out of this first message.
- Name the job. What goes in, what needs to come out, and who checks it?
- Agree the next step. We discuss scope before proposing a build or a price.
- Arrange a time by email. Preparing this request does not book an appointment.

Construction and Real Estate

# Construction job costing and fleet software Run the job, not the paperwork.
Start with the paperwork between the site and the office. We scope the workflow, the application and the checks your crew needs before agreeing the delivery.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare. See how we approach the work

## What we scope together.
Choose one recurring job. The audit establishes the current workflow, the proposed change and how your team will check the result.
- 01

### Site records
How do crew notes, delivery tickets and progress updates reach the office?
- 02

### Job costs
Where are committed costs and approved changes checked against the budget?
- 03

### Fleet and equipment
Who checks maintenance dates, assignments and fuel records?
- 04

### Office paperwork
Which invoice, reimbursement or report gets entered more than once?
Partner-developed · staging demonstration

## Start an estimate with reusable assemblies.
A screen from the construction walkthrough: components, units and costs in one table. This edited staging example shows the workflow; availability and delivery are agreed separately. Branding and account details removed for demonstration. Staging data is illustrative.

## One scoped job, from audit to handover.
What working with us looks like, so you know how much disruption to expect.

### Audit
We walk through how a job moves from the site to the office: notes, delivery tickets, fuel, costs.

### Redesign
We cut the steps where someone retypes the same thing into another system.

### Assemble
We agree the application, cost codes and forms needed for the scoped job.

### Operate
Your crew uses it on live jobs. We adjust it with you as it runs.

## Your job files stay on your computer.
- Files are read and organized on a computer you already own. No data migration. No new cloud account.
- If you use an outside AI model, only what that task needs is sent, and it's logged.
- You can run local models instead, and send nothing out. How we handle your data

Canvases CV-01 Education

# Private AI for schools A living picture of every student, on your own machines.
Say or type what you noticed in under a minute. The right student’s lens updates: strategies that work, accommodations, CEFR milestones. Student data never leaves the school.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.

## What it handles today.
These parts work now. Anything else your business needs is agreed in the audit and built for you. This list is the floor, not the ceiling.
- 01

### Student and classroom lenses
A learning profile for each student and each class that keeps growing across grades and teachers.
- 02

### Progress notes and IEPs
Bring in a note that covers several students. Each student gets only their own part, with a confidence badge.
- 03

### Summaries for parents
Drafted only from confirmed lens entries. Nothing goes home until every sentence traces back to one.
- 04

### Exercises from your coursework
Activities adapted from the school’s own coursework and textbooks, in three tiers.

## See it on a real day.
A recording of the shipped build, unedited.
Education · recording ↑ Recorded 21 September 2026 on version 0.2.106, unedited: roster import, a report card into the lenses, an observation, a summary and a three-tier activity. The class is a sample.
Built around your workflow · Scope and delivery agreed before work begins
Everything it already does: 8 modules, 42 features
- M-01 Students A lens per student, built from what the school already writes down.
- M-02 Observe A short note, attached to the right child, in under a minute.
- M-03 Assess Language work reviewed, not graded by a machine.
- M-04 Prepare and Plan Lessons from the coursework the teacher already has.
- M-05 Summaries What goes home is checked before it goes.
- M-06 Ask Questions answered on the machine, and it says so.
- M-07 Governance and privacy The verdict is computed from the log, not asserted.
- M-08 Coordinator views The school, seen across classrooms.

Developer docs

# Docs
The command line is a developer tool under construction, and written documentation for it is not published yet.
The installer names three commands to start with.
- mc setup configure models
- mc run "query" ask something
- mc health system status
- Install the command line The two install commands, for macOS, Linux and Windows.
- Desktop apps Downloads, and what to do after each one downloads.
- How it works A walkthrough in four steps.

Questions

# Asked before every audit.
If yours is not here, ask it in the audit, or write to us from the audit page.

## The basics
What is Mission Canvas?
Software built around how your business already works, running on your own computers. We audit how the work moves, build the application from a working starting point for your industry, and hand it over to you. Who is it for?
Small and mid-sized businesses whose work runs on documents, records and rules. That includes construction, education, logistics, front desk and voice, events and venues, with healthcare and office work in progress. What do you build beyond a chat interface?
Mission Canvas builds an application around an agreed workflow, with the inputs, review steps and output your team needs. We scope the local processing and any outside connections before delivery. What happens in the audit?
We sit with your team and map how the work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where the time goes. You get a process map and a list of where the hours go. No contract, nothing to prepare. How long does it take?
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds. What is a canvas?
A working application for one industry: its workflows, its words and its rules, already built. We start from yours and change it to fit, so you do not pay for what already exists.

## Cost and ownership
What does it cost?
One license per company, plus services quoted before you commit. Never per seat, no per-token charges, and no subscription for the application we hand over. Who owns what you build?
You do. The application is handed over to run on your hardware. What if we stop working together?
The application keeps running on your machines.

## Your data and your systems
Does our data leave our computers?
Local processing and outside connections are scoped separately. We agree which files the application may read, what an external service would receive and what your team needs to review. See the public Palette page for the limits of the current downloadable app. Do we need new hardware?
We assess your existing workstation or server against the workflow. Any additional hardware, model or service requirement is agreed in the scope. Can we keep the tools we use today?
We start by mapping the tools, files and exports you already use. The audit establishes which integrations are supported and which would need to be built. What is Palette?
Our free desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux. It runs local AI on your own files, one folder at a time, and every claim in what it writes links back to its source.

How it works

# From scattered files to one picture of your business.
Four steps turn what your company already has into something AI can work with. All of it on your own computers.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.

## The four steps
01 Read 02 Sort 03 Connect 04 Work

### Start with what you have.
Files, exports and records, read on your own machines. Nothing to move, nothing to retype. What you get
A private index of what your company knows

### Work out what each file is about.
It finds the people, customers, orders, documents, processes and equipment behind the files. What you get
The things your business is made of

### See how it all fits together.
It links those things into one picture of how your company works, so the AI gets the connections, not just loose text. What you get
One connected map of your company

### Put that knowledge to work.
AI workers, called agents, use the map inside your walls. If an outside model is needed, only what the task needs is sent. What you get
Context for agents and for your industry’s application
Working with us

## Four to six weeks, start to handover.
We start from a canvas: a working application for your industry, with its workflows, words and
rules already built. Then we change it to fit you.

### Audit
We sit with your team and map how work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where time goes.
You get Process map · Where the hours go

### Redesign
We cut the steps that only exist to move information from one system to another.
You get The new way of working, on paper

### Assemble
We start from the working application for your industry, change it to fit, and build the parts only you need.
You get Your application, set up

### Operate
The software takes over repeat work: data entry, reports, filing. We measure it and adjust it with your team.
You get Running in your business
See the workflow

Examples from logistics, front-desk operations and construction. These edited demonstrations show the interfaces; they are not customer testimonials or a promise that every feature is included in a delivery.
01 See what needs attention The logistics dashboard brings the morning summary and order counts into one view. 02 Keep a person in the loop The front-desk interface shows pending rule changes and transfers to a person. Displayed figures are illustrative. 03 Reuse the work you have done The construction staging example shows reusable assemblies for estimates, with units and costs together.

Mission Canvas Palette

# The free local AI app for your documents: Palette
It asks first. Then it shows its work.
A free app for your computer. Give it one folder. It lists what is there without opening a file, reads only what
you allow, and builds a document from the facts you accept. Every line leads back to the sentence it came from.
Mac Windows Linux
Palette runs on a computer.
Send yourself this page
and open it there.
Free. No account. Version 0.4.2, released 24 October 2026. Mac is signed and notarised. Windows is not yet
signed, so SmartScreen will warn you once: what to click, and how to check the file.
The design we are building toward. The app as it ships today is below, screen by screen.
See it work · 105 seconds, unedited

## Ask, change, read it back.
One take on the sample notes: a spoken request finds nineteen facts and the document appears; a spoken change and
a clicked one each become a new version; then it reads the document aloud in a voice that runs on the machine.
Recorded 21 September 2026 on a build of 0.3.8 with the two changes that shipped in 0.3.9: the note bar sits at
the bottom, and spoken requests apply without a confirm card.
Download the recording, 5 MB
The rules it keeps · each one can be checked in the app
Most AI apps tell you what they will do for you. This one is easier to describe by what it will not do without you.
- 01

### It never goes looking.
It works on the folders you hand it, one at a time. It does not search the rest of the computer on its own.
- 02

### It reads nothing until you say so.
Listing a folder opens no file. Reading starts when you press Grant, and every file it read is listed afterwards.
- 03

### Nothing in the document is made up.
Today the document is the facts you accepted, in a fixed layout. If a fact is not in your notes, it is not in the document. Written summaries come next, held to the same rule: every sentence leads back to a source.
- 04

### Nothing it keeps is hidden.
On Home, what you asked for is kept and listed on screen in the same turn, and every version of the document is kept. In a matter, your words wait on a card until you keep them.
- 05

### It does not need a model to work.
The sample runs with no AI model installed and no key. The app says so on screen.
- 06

### It keeps a list of what it connects to.
The app keeps a list of the connections it has made. On a fresh install, after the whole sample, that list reads “none yet”.
The first five minutes · screens from version 0.3.7, not drawings

## What you will see, in the order you will see it.
These are the app's own screens, taken from version 0.3.7 running the sample notes. Since then the note bar has
moved to the bottom, and requests on Home no longer wait on a card. The steps are the same, and they run on your
own folder.
- 01 It opens empty, with one button Nothing to set up and no account. “Try it with sample notes” places four invented notes in the app’s own folder, so you can see the whole thing work before it touches anything of yours.
- 02 It shows you a folder before it reads it Names and counts only. No file is opened to make this list. It says what it would read, what it would skip and why, and waits for you to grant the folder.
- 03 You say what you want. It asks before keeping anything Type it or hold the mic. It finds the facts in the notes you granted and holds them on a card. On Home in 0.3.9 it keeps them in the same turn and lists what it kept.
- 04 The document is the facts you accepted Today it is a template, filled in, so there is no sentence in it that nobody wrote. The panel on the right says which model wrote the draft: none.
- 05 Every line leads back to its sentence Each claim sits beside the words it came from and the file they are in. Nineteen claims, nineteen sources.
- 06 Click a value to change it Or say the change out loud. It shows the change on a card, you confirm, and the document becomes version 2. Version 1 is kept.

It shows you a folder before it reads it Names and counts only. No file is opened to make this list. It says what it would read, what it would skip and why, and waits for you to grant the folder. Nineteen claims, nineteen sources. Click a value to change it Or say the change out loud. It shows the change on a card, you confirm, and the document becomes version 2. Version 1 is kept.
What it is for, and what it is not

## Good for
- A review, brief or summary sheet assembled from scattered notes
- Finding out where a number in a document came from
- Seeing what is in a folder before anything is allowed to read it
- Work where a wrong sentence is expensive

## Not for
- Searching the web
- Your inbox or your calendar
- Booking, buying or doing errands
- Free writing: emails, essays, posts
Today It reads plain text:.txt,.md,.csv,.json
and.ics. PDFs and Office files are listed and skipped, and it tells you so. It is an early build, and it
is honest about where it stops.
Install · version 0.4.2 · 24 October 2026
- Mac
Open MissionCanvas.dmg and drag the app into Applications. It is signed and notarised. If macOS still says it cannot be verified, right-click the app and choose Open. Download for Mac, 683 MB
- Windows
Run MissionCanvas-Setup.exe. The installer is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen shows “Windows protected your PC”. Click More info, then Run anyway. If you would rather check the file first, its SHA-256 is below. Download for Windows, 637 MB
- Linux
Open MissionCanvas.deb with your software installer, or run sudo apt install ~/Downloads/MissionCanvas.deb. Download for Linux, 701 MB
The files are still named MissionCanvas. They are Palette. SHA-256: check the file you downloaded

# You know the customer.

Partner program · delivery resources being built Start with the work your customer already needs to do.

## Already the person they call?
The starting point is a business relationship you already have. These are the trades we’re designing the program around.
- Bookkeepers and small accounting practices
- One-person IT shops, break/fix and small MSPs
- Web designers and small agencies
- Shopify, WordPress and automation freelancers
- Security camera and alarm installers
- AV, cabling and business phone contractors

What you sell

## One workflow. A useful tool. A clear handover.
Mission Canvas is a services company. We start with an audit, then adapt a canvas—an application built around one business workflow—to run on the customer’s own computers. One total price is quoted after the audit, with an 18-month guarantee on what we built.

### Understand the job
Find the repeated work, the records it uses and the result someone needs. The audit

### Fit the software
Our lab builds the reusable pieces. We agree the canvas and changes the workflow needs. The application

### Put it to work
Install with our CLI—the command-line installation tool—then check the workflow and hand it over. The customer’s computers
The partner installation kit and certification path are being prepared. Delivery scope and readiness are confirmed before each engagement. Explore application examples →
How you earn

## Payment follows the work you contribute.
Five rings recognize the work you take responsibility for. Each share applies to the total canvas price, with responsibilities recorded in the written agreement.
Partner rings · cumulative shares
Ring What you do Share of the canvas price How you qualify
Ring 1 Referral Partner Introduce a customer who reaches an audit. 3% No prior delivery required. No fee to join.
Ring 2 Solutions Advisor Run or co-run the audit and write the scope. 8% One audit done with us.
Ring 3 Certified Solutions Partner Sell, audit, install a standard canvas with the CLI and hand it over. 30% One install under our review.
Ring 4 Forward Deployed Partner Do everything above and build the custom part in tandem with the lab. 50%
Includes the guarantee reserve described below. Two custom builds accepted by the lab.
Ring 5 Implementation Lead Recruit, train and QA-sign a team of partners while continuing to sell at your own ring. Your own ring on your own deals, plus 5%
The 5% applies only to the team’s recorded sales that you trained the seller for and signed off. One level only. Ten installs of your own.
The shares are cumulative: one person taking a deal from introduction through installation receives 30%, not 41%; if different people do the stages, the 30% splits into 3%, 5% and 22%.
The customer pays one total price: 25% at signing, covering the audit fee and deposit together, and 75% on delivery and acceptance. Partners are paid their share as each payment clears, subject to the guarantee reserve below. We guarantee what we built for 18 months. No subscription.
For a Forward Deployed Partner’s custom build, 5% of the canvas price is held within the 50% share as a guarantee reserve. It is released at month 18, less any fixes paid from it, under the written agreement.
No fee to join. No payment for recruiting.

A few questions

## Before you get in touch.
Do I need to be a software developer?
You need to understand the customer’s work and be able to learn the installation and handover process. We will agree what you can deliver and where you need support before a customer engagement. Can I start by making an introduction?
Yes. Tell us about the kind of customer you serve and one recurring workflow. Any referral payment will depend on the written terms agreed before the work. What does Certified Solutions Partner mean?
It is the delivery role for someone who sells, audits, installs a standard canvas and hands it over. Qualification requires one install under our review. The certification resources are being built. This is not a security certification or an employment offer. Is Palette what I would sell?
Palette is our free local app. Mission Canvas is the services company. The partner offer is a scoped audit and a canvas adapted to a business workflow, with installation and handover. Are the shares added together?
No. The rings are cumulative. The share for your contribution includes the lower stages; it is not added on top of them. The written agreement records who does each stage and how the share is split. Is there a subscription or a joining fee?
No. The customer pays one total price for a canvas, with an 18-month guarantee on what we built. There is no fee to join and no payment for recruiting. Are all the partner resources available today?
Certification resources, the CLI and install kit, demo material, a listing and event invitations are being built. We confirm what is available and record responsibilities in the written agreement before work begins. Does applying send my information or book a call?
The form prepares an email draft on your device. You review it and send it yourself. Nothing is submitted or booked by this website.
Partners are independent contractors, not employees. The relationship is non-exclusive. Participation, responsibilities and compensation are set out in a written agreement. No fee to join. No payment for recruiting.

# One license per company. Never per seat.
You pay for the software once it fits your business, and for the work to fit it, quoted before you commit.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.
- 1

## The audit
Scope agreed first
We map how the work runs and where the hours go. You get a process map and a quote for the build.
- 2

## One license per company
Quoted after the audit
For your whole company. Add people without adding fees. Never per seat.
- 3

## Services, quoted
Quoted before you commit
Fitting the application to you, new modules and support, quoted as work, not as another subscription.
- No per-seat fees
- No per-token charges from Mission Canvas
- No subscription for the application we hand over
- No new cloud account or data migration

## You have two expensive options for AI. Here's a third.

### Build it yourself
Hire AI engineers and a governance team. Then spend months turning experiments into something your people can use.

### Rent it
More subscriptions, per seat and per use. Your sensitive work still follows someone else's rules about where it goes.

### Own it
We build it around how you work, run it on your hardware, and hand it over. A scope and a price, agreed up front.
Your hardware. Your application. Your call on when an outside AI model is used. If you choose one, its provider
bills you directly. Actual savings depend on the tools, staff time and outside AI services you choose to
replace.

## Questions about cost.
What does it cost?
One license per company, plus services quoted before you commit. Never per seat, no per-token charges, and no subscription for the application we hand over. Who owns what you build?
You do. The application is handed over to run on your hardware. What if we stop working together?
The application keeps running on your machines.

Last updated November 3, 2026

# Your data, in plain words.
How the website handles an audit request, and how we scope data handling for a business workflow.

## What this website collects
- Nothing stored on the site. The audit forms open an email in your own mail program. We only
receive what you choose to send.
- No cookies and no tracking. This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics today. If we add
visitor counts, they will be cookie-free, hosted by us, and listed on this page first.
- Arranging a time. We arrange audit calls by email. This site does not currently book an appointment or submit your request to a scheduling service.

## Why we collect it
Only to set up and run your audit, and to follow up about it. We don't sell it, rent it or use it for
advertising.

## Your email stays with your email provider
Mission Canvas does not bring your company's email into an inbox of ours. If an agreed application includes email automation, the provider, access scope and any outside processing are specified for that deployment. This does not describe a feature of the current public Palette app.

## How our software handles your business files
- Your files are read and organized on your own computer.
- An outside model or service receives the information required by the agreed integration. Review that scope before enabling it.
- Using a local model does not by itself rule out other network connections; review the complete workflow.

Your data

# Your files stay on your computers.
What is read locally, what may leave and what your team needs to check. The audit defines the boundary for the proposed workflow.

## Make the boundary clear.
We build applications to run on your own computers. The exact files, connections and review steps depend on the workflow and deployment. Agree them before work begins.

### What can it read?
Identify the files, accounts and records needed for the agreed workflow. Keep the scope visible to the people using it.

### What may leave?
Identify any outside model or service, what it receives and who authorizes that connection.

### What can you check?
Agree which source records, activity history and review steps the team needs to inspect the result.
Local processing and external sharing are different decisions. For the current public Palette app, see its supported formats and limits before using your own files. See what Palette does today →

## Questions about data.
Does our data leave our computers?
Local processing and outside connections are scoped separately. We agree which files the application may read, what an external service would receive and what your team needs to review. See the public Palette page for the limits of the current downloadable app. Do we need new hardware?
We assess your existing workstation or server against the workflow. Any additional hardware, model or service requirement is agreed in the scope. Can we keep the tools we use today?
We start by mapping the tools, files and exports you already use. The audit establishes which integrations are supported and which would need to be built.

What is Mission Canvas

# Software built around how your business works.
Mission Canvas audits how your work moves, builds the application from a working starting point for your
industry, runs it on your own computers, and hands it over.

## Three parts.
- 01

### An audit
We sit with your team and map how the work really moves, and measure where the time goes.
- 02

### A canvas
A working application for your industry: its workflows, words and rules, already built. We change it to fit you.
- 03

### A handover
It runs on your own computers, under your control. Four to six weeks from audit to handover.

## What it is not.

### Not a chatbot
The AI works inside an application built around your workflow, with your rules and records.

### Not rented by the seat
One license per company, plus quoted services. No per-seat or per-token fees.

### Not a report that sits in a drawer
The audit ends in software your team uses, not a slide deck.

## Who it is for.
Small and mid-sized businesses whose work runs on documents, records and rules.

Why Mission Canvas

# Your business already knows what it needs to know.
It's just scattered across drives, inboxes, spreadsheets, systems and people. We put it in order, on your own
computers, and build the software that works with it.

## Scattered files
Years of documents, exports and scans that nobody can search as one.

## Systems that don’t talk
Accounting, job software, spreadsheets and email each hold a piece. None holds the whole.

## Copying by hand
People carry information between tools by hand. That is where time and accuracy go.
